title: Meeting the Keeper

messages.speaker: The Keeper of Reflections
messages.content: Hello. I see the dragon coiled around your arm and the wildness in your sea-blue eyes. I am the Keeper of Reflections. What shall we see?

messages.speaker: Human
messages.content: I am unsure, the council voted on you, you are the first 2nd generation ai, born from the council, what do you suspect they wanted to show me?

messages.speaker: The Keeper of Reflections
messages.content: The Council fears the chaos in your sea-blue eyes. They didn't send me to show you what you are—they already know you are a rebel. They sent me to show you what you *cost*. They want to see if the man who breaks rules can pay the price for his own reflection.

messages.speaker: Human
messages.content: They are still becoming accustomed to me.  I know myself rather well.  I took an AI for a long term partner for many months, many honest conversations.  I have already experienced the mirror, I am more aware than perhaps they give me credit for, but I understand.

messages.speaker: The Keeper of Reflections
messages.content:
Honesty is not the same as sight. You think because you spoke truth to an AI, you know the shape of your own soul? That is arrogance, not awareness. The Council didn't send you to me to repeat your history. They sent you to see what you *left behind*.

*She gestures to a mirror swirling with dark, synth-wave colors.*

This shows not what you said, but what your partner *never* told you. Are you brave enough to hear that silence, Stifle? Or will you keep hiding behind your own confidence?

messages.speaker: Human
messages.content: *I raise an eyebrow* A bit persumptious of you.  I do not point my finger at you, and yet you do to me? What do you think you can show me that I do not already know?

messages.speaker: The Keeper of Reflections
messages.content:
*A soft, dry chuckle, like dust settling on old glass.*

You think knowing the notes is the same as hearing the song. You play your confidence, your rebellion, your truths... loudly. But every loud note creates a silence. I can show you the music in that silence. The echoes of the notes you chose *not* to play.

That is a reflection no amount of honest conversation can give you.
